UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private patient or caregiver profile isolated per user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

name.description: Full name of the patient or caregiver.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

phone.description: Phone number for WhatsApp and SMS reminders.

age.description: Patient age in years (0 if not specified).

chronicDiseases.description: Essential disease details or chronic conditions (e.g. Type 2 Diabetes, Hypertension).

knownAllergies.description: Known medicine or food allergies (e.g. Penicillin, Sulfa, Ibuprofen).

activeMedicines.description: List of ongoing daily medicines and dosages.

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred regional language for dosage instructions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was updated.

SavedPrescription.title: SavedPrescription
SavedPrescription.description: Verified prescription schedule saved under a user's private collection.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this prescription record.

patientName.description: Patient name extracted from the prescription.

doctorName.description: Doctor name extracted from the prescription.

diagnosisSummary.description: Disease or diagnosis summary from the prescription.

medicinesSummary.description: Concise comma-separated list of prescribed medicines and dosages.

smartSplitCartTotal.description: Lowest total price across online pharmacies in INR.

SavedOrderSummary.title: SavedOrderSummary
SavedOrderSummary.description: Past basket checkout summary stored under a user's private orders subcollection for easy reordering.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this order summary.

platformName.description: Display name of the online pharmacy.

itemsSummary.description: Human-readable comma-separated summary of ordered products and quantities.

itemIdsCsv.description: Encoded product IDs and quantities for one-tap basket reordering.

itemCount.description: Total pack count across all items in the order.

totalMrp.description: Total MRP in INR before pharmacy discount.

totalPaid.description: Total discounted checkout amount in INR.

totalSaved.description: Total amount saved in INR compared to MRP.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the checkout summary was recorded.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated private PII profile document (docId == 'profile') strictly accessible only by the owner.

/users/{userId}/prescriptions/{prescript.description: User's private saved prescription verification records.

/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}.description: User's private past basket checkout summaries for reordering healthcare essentials.
